events.name: NUTCRACKER! Magical Christmas Ballet
events.info: Make this the Christmas they'll never forget with NUTCRACKER! Magical Christmas Ballet. Experience the largest Nutcracker production in North America - a breathtaking holiday spectacle featuring world-class international dancers, gravity-defying acrobatics, magnificent costumes, and towering puppets. Set to Tchaikovsky's iconic score, this grand production transforms the stage into an unforgettable celebration of the season - one your family will treasure for years to come. Get tickets now at nutcracker.com!

events.name: Milk Man & The Big Band
events.info: Milk Man & The Big Band is one of the most unexpected acts to come along in ages. Led by singer-songwriter Dino ?Milk Man? Nassios, the group is a 21-piece rock/pop unit, complete with brass, strings, analog-only keyboards, and back-up singers. The group has been wowing audiences in Knoxville, Tennessee, since 2021 with a brash and lovable style that doesn?t fit neatly into any category. With the album ?Let Me Tell You,? Milk Man & The Big Band unleash the 13 original songs that are sure to spread the band?s reputation around the globe. With their second release "Milk Man Live In Concert," the band proved their ability to bring these complex arrangements to the stage, as well as play the classic hits of The Beatles, The Doors, Pink Floyd, and more.
events.pleaseNote: Please note that balcony-level seating is accessible only by stairs; there is no elevator access to the balcony level. This is a general admission event. We reserve the right to revoke tickets sold through brokers or unauthorized third parties. If your ticket is revoked, you will not be admitted and will not receive a refund. Event date, time, and supporting acts are subject to change. All sales are final. No refunds or exchanges. Tickets will be available approximately 24 hours before the event.

boxOfficeInfo.phoneNumberDetail: For ticket purchases or show-related inquiries, please contact the Tennessee Theatre Box Office at 865-684-1200, option 2. For other inquires, please call 865-522-0832.
boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: Bijou Theatre doors typically open one hour prior to showtime and tickets can be purchased at Will Call. Advance tickets can be purchased from the Tennessee Theatre Box Office during business hours
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Will Call can be picked up inside the Bijou Theatre lobby the day of the performance typically one hour prior to the performance. Please have photo ID ready for ticket retrieval.

venues.parkingDetail: Several parking lots and on-street metered spaces are located within walking distance of the Bijou Theatre. The closest parking is a pay lot, Republic Parking, next to the venue on Cumberland. The State Street, Market Square, Dwight Kessel, and Locust Street garages are free after 6 p.m. on weekdays and all day on weekends.
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: The Bijou Theatre has ADA seating in the lower level only. The venue does not have an elevator to the balcony level. For more information, please call the Bijou Theatre at 865-522-0832.

generalInfo.generalRule: Weapons of any kind, including pocketknives; outside food and beverages; smoking of any kind, including e-cigarettes; illegal substances; professional or flash photography, tripods, selfie-sticks; backpacks, bags, oversized purses, etc. are prohibited at the venue. Clear bags are not required. For the safety and security of all patrons, all persons and items entering the Bijou Theatre are subject to search. The Bijou Theatre reserves the right to prohibit any item, including items not listed above, from entering the premises based on any particular show request or requirement. A variety of beverages and snacks are sold at concessions and are allowed in the auditorium. We are a cashless venue.
generalInfo.childRule: For most events, children aged 2 and up will require a ticket. Children under age 2 that will not be occupying a seat do not need to purchase a ticket. events.name: Be Like Blippi Tour - Photo Experience
events.info: Meet Blippi ON STAGE and have the opportunity to take your photo with Blippi in this one-of-a-kind Photo Experience! You'll also receive a souvenir tour lanyard with a Be Like Blippi Tour Pass to commemorate the day. Don't miss your chance to create unforgettable, treasured memories with your children that will last a lifetime! Parents, please note that while most children are excited to meet their favorite characters up-close, others can feel frightened. If your child is scared or hesitant to meet Blippi, we recommend moving to the back of the line; This will allow your child the extra time they may need to warm up to Blippi and see how they interact with other children present. ** Admission to the performance is not included in the Photo Experience ticket. This is a separate upgrade that must be purchased in advance. **Children aged 12 and under must be accompanied by a Parent/Guardian. Each Child, Parent or Guardian must have a show ticket as well as the Photo Experience.
